transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Thank you. ...Well, I suppose I'm just having a hard time sitting down and being still lately. For the past year or so, I just... I don't know, I'm always puttering around. Fixing things, arranging things. I keep volunteering for one more thing, even though I'm 87. It just feels like I can't just... sit.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep than usual to feel rested?
No... I don't think so. My sleep is... well, it's just normal, I suppose. I haven't really noticed any change with that.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about everyday matters or anticipating that something bad might happen?
No... I wouldn't say so. I don't really dwell on things like that. Just... no, not really.
Have you been feeling unusually energized, cheerful, or on top of the world lately?
No... I don't think so. I just feel like myself, I suppose. Not unusually cheerful or anything like that.
Have you or anyone close to you noticed any difficulties with your memory?
No... my memory is fine, I think. I haven't noticed any problems... and nobody else has said anything to me about it. Just normal, really.
Have you noticed any unexpected weight loss recently?
No... not that I've noticed. My weight is just... about the same as always, I think.
Are you currently taking any prescription medications on a regular basis?
No... I'm not taking anything. Just... no medications right now.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless lately?
No... not really. I feel... fine, mostly. Just... ordinary, I suppose.
How much coffee, tea, or other caffeinated drinks do you typically have in a day?
No... I don't really drink any of that. No coffee or tea. Just... none, really.
Do you experience any uncomfortable sensations in your legs that give you an urge to move them?
No... I don't think so. My legs feel... fine, really. Just... no strange feelings like that.
When you do try to sit still, do you feel an uncomfortable inner restlessness or anxiety?

Well... I suppose sometimes. Like at the senior center meetings, or... when church announcements go on for too long. I get this... sort of ants-in-my-chair feeling. I usually have to shift around, or... maybe get up for a coffee, or just straighten my papers. Just to get through it, I guess.
When you were a child, did you have trouble sitting still or feel like you were always on the go?

Well... that was a very long time ago. But... yes, I suppose so. I remember getting scolded in grade school quite a bit. Just for... popping out of my seat, mostly. And talking over my classmates. The teachers just told my parents I was too lively... long before I was even a teenager. That's... really all I remember about it.
Do you often have trouble keeping your attention focused on tasks or activities?
No... I don't believe so. If I have something to do, I just... do it. I haven't really noticed any trouble paying attention to things.
